identityRules: NPNF editorial volumes are Edition/container witnesses, never automatic Work identities.
Homily, hymn and epistle collections may remain collection-level Works when the historical source presents them as coherent authored corpora; individual items remain child ReadingUnits.
Original-language witnesses and historical English translations attach to the same canonical Work when identity is secure.
Generated zh-Hant remains a reading projection, never a fabricated Chinese Edition.
Scripture quotations embedded in patristic works remain contextual quotations; Bible text/translation products themselves remain excluded.
visualEnrichment: Resolve NPNF title pages/edition images as Edition visuals while separately seeking authentic work-specific historical title pages where available.
next: Continue work-level admission beyond the initial NPNF patristic core, then deduplicate these identities against PRDL/CatholicCorpus and attach cover/title-page plus translation eligibility states.
